Tests VM curve syscall multiscalar mul and group ops for valid and invalid cases.

# Purpose
This file is a test program for `fd_vm_syscall_sol_curve_multiscalar_mul` and `fd_vm_syscall_sol_curve_group_op` in the VM syscall layer. It creates a minimal `fd_vm_t` instance, sets up execution and transaction context objects, enables all features, and initializes VM memory with test data. The code then calls the syscalls with invalid and valid inputs and checks the returned status codes, error codes, and output bytes against expected values.

The main focus is curve arithmetic for `FD_VM_SYSCALL_SOL_CURVE_CURVE25519_EDWARDS` and `FD_VM_SYSCALL_SOL_CURVE_CURVE25519_RISTRETTO`. The helper functions [`test_vm_syscall_sol_curve_multiscalar_mul`](<#test_vm_syscall_sol_curve_multiscalar_mul>) and [`test_fd_vm_syscall_sol_curve_group_op`](<#test_fd_vm_syscall_sol_curve_group_op>) wrap each syscall call, verify the result, clear transaction context errors, and compare the result point in VM memory with the expected host buffer. The [`main`](<#main>) function runs cases for error handling, multiscalar multiplication, point addition, point subtraction, and scalar multiplication, then cleans up the VM, SHA-256, and RNG objects before exiting.
